title: Major Experience Update (v5.0.0)
summary: CogniFocus 5.0 rebuilds the onboarding and app atmosphere from the ground up, ships a real Focus Shards progression system, sharpens Goblin reactions, and cleans up Shield flows across the board.

Massive UI/UX overhaul across large parts of the app

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Completely redesigned onboarding and app atmosphere
- Massive UI/UX overhaul across large parts of the app
- New Focus Shards progression system

## Improvements

- Improved Goblin reactions, animations, and progression feedback
- Better Shield flows, interruption handling, and overall polish

## Why this matters

v5.0.0 is not a tweak. The onboarding flow was rebuilt from the ground up so new users land in a clearer, calmer atmosphere before their first session starts. The UI/UX overhaul touches most of the app: spacing, transitions, visual hierarchy and the way the Goblin reacts to what you do during a session.

Focus Shards replace a placeholder progression system with something real. Every session earns Shards, and Shards unlock milestones. The Goblin now reacts more accurately to your behavior, whether you're on a streak, slipping, or coming back after a rough day.

Shield flows are cleaner under the hood. Interruption handling is more predictable and the finish-session path has fewer dead ends. If you've been using CogniFocus for a while, this one should feel noticeably different.
